name: 85284 · Tempe, AZ
findings: ZIP 85284 (Tempe) has 115 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85284 (Tempe) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 85284 (Tempe) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
